 if scope['hand_policy']=='zero_proved_inert':

 pa,pb=record_value(a.position),record_value(b.position)
 pa.pop('ruleset_fingerprint');pb.pop('ruleset_fingerprint')
 assert pa==pb, 'physical+aux+shape state differs'
 def link(x,y):

 link(position_identity_key(a.position,ca),position_identity_key(b.position,cb))
